Per last ACDC, I have renamed and reduced the scope of EIP-8365 to guarding new 0x00 validators in ethereum/EIPs#12389 

Would love to get a decision on whether to include it for Hegota.

The force exiting 0x00 validators portion is now a standalone EIP (EIP-8433, ethereum/EIPs#12390) and will be proposed at a later fork.

## Mascot needed for Hegotá upgrade

Suggestions wanted.  The mascot MUST relate thematically to one or more of the headliners, the namesakes of the network upgrade’s layer names (e.g., the execution layer city or the consensus layer star), or the client interop events for the network upgrade.

https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/mascot-needed-for-hegota-upgrade/28327

I would like to have a quick discussion about delivery speed and hardfork schedule. The goal - at least 4 hardforks of current size per year.

In Nethermind we currently prototyped all [CFI'ed Hegota EIPs in 120 PR's](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pulls?q=is%3Apr+in%3Atitle+%283298+OR+7668+OR+7906+OR+7979+OR+8131+OR+8163+OR+8250+OR+8253+OR+8272+OR+8279%29) . We could start testing Hegota hardfork now. We are currently testing headliner only.

Secondly @banteg leads [cross-EL-client trace standardization initiative](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/issues/890). Multiple clients already merged [multiple PR's](https://github.com/banteg/trace-interop/blob/main/reports/README.md#progress) based on it. The initiative is great success, while being AI driven. At the end the reviewer and decision makers are always core developers.

Inspired by both we would like to first understand each clients and involved teams (security/testing/devops) bottlenecks on faster hardfork delivery. Historically this was both implementation, testing, integration and coordination. Each having it's own toll.

When we will understand that better we want to propose set of tools and and changes, with the goal of increasing delivery speed. We would like to collaborate on that with all clients and teams.

Our initial ideas revolve around:
- automating testing drafts
- automating fixes drafts
- automating devnets (devnet per EIP + integration)
- automation of uncovering spec gaps drafts
- automation of security audits drafts

In our opinion none of those should replace humans, and human judgement should always be used for final decisions.

This would also need to parallelize fork work even more.

Tell us what you think. Let's go faster.

**Withdrawing EIP-8333 (Align Checkpoint with Epoch Boundary Block) — removing it from Hegotá CL scoping**

As authors of [EIP-8333](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8333), we'd like to withdraw it, and it does not need call time for Hegotá scoping.

After a closer look at the decoupled-consensus / 3SF direction, we no longer think 8333 is worth pursuing. 3SF removes epochs from the fork-choice and finality design entirely and moves to slot-based checkpointing, so "anchor the checkpoint for epoch `N` to the epoch boundary block" has no referent there — and the first-slot target-vote miss it addresses does not arise once checkpoints are slot-based rather than tied to an epoch's first slot.

Landing 8333 in Hegotá would mean every CL client migrating checkpoint-state handling, fork-choice target resolution, and finalized pruning — i.e. exactly the machinery decoupled consensus redesigns — for roughly a fork of benefit before it is replaced. The underlying first-slot propagation inefficiency is long-standing and minor (`consensus-specs` issues 2174 / 652), and we're comfortable letting the finality redesign subsume it rather than churning clients ahead of it.

We'll follow up with a PR moving the EIP to `Withdrawn`.

cc co-authors @wemeetagain @nflaig @twoeths

This can probably just be a comment in the chat (which I will drop during the H-star discussion) rather than discussed unless someone else wants to engage or we want to show off the below calculator site, but I just want to flag that the update to EIP7716 has been merged https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7716 and that anyone interested in this EIP and may not have seen the 2026 update to the EIP can give it a look now. 

I also put together an FAQ site to get a feel for the increased penalties in the EIP, interested people can check it out here https://validatordowntime.obol.org/
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
